gen-gf-autour-one-noto-serif: Autour One is cut like an engraving, every stroke at a single depth with a clear channel into each round letter, while Noto Serif adds a faint thick-thin cadence. Try it at a generous heading size.
gen-gf-baloo-2-archivo: Archivo reads with a commanding lowercase, its curves opening outward rather than curling back in. Archivo meets Baloo 2's rounded, spacious display letters, and that sturdy-meets-soft mix is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-baloo-2-fs-asap: Baloo 2 spreads its open counters into the white space, each bowl filling out the line. And Asap, a sans-serif with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, gives that exuberance a steady footing underneath.
gen-gf-baloo-2-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Be Vietnam Pro reads like bent steel rod, a plain stripe of constant ink. Under Baloo 2's looser, bowl-heavy display letters, it keeps the page grounded while the heading does the talking.
gen-gf-baloo-2-fs-epilogue: Epilogue reads like tracing a single thick thread, curvy and unclamped, with stubby ascender tips. Epilogue and Baloo 2 both lean friendly and round, so the pair's strongest quality is its shared warmth.
gen-gf-baloo-2-fs-fira-sans: Chunky and open up top, wiry below: Baloo 2 fills its lines with generous bowls while Fira Sans looks cut from wire, with big x-height. One is plump, the other taut.
gen-gf-baloo-2-fs-merriweather-sans: Baloo 2 brings expressive, bowl-filled display letters with open counters that breathe. Merriweather Sans follows in a plain sans with tall, sturdy-looking words, and its clear-eyed e is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-baloo-2-fs-public-sans: Public Sans gives you a hefty lowercase with broad, open counters on c and s. And Baloo 2 above it, expressive and round, fills its lines with bowls that make the text below feel even sturdier.
gen-gf-baloo-2-fs-ranade: Ranade reads spread out and organic, its weight shifting slightly like stretched rubber cord, crossbars a touch slimmer than the stems. Ranade then sits beneath Baloo 2's low-contrast, bowl-filled display letters, loosening the whole page.
gen-gf-baloo-2-general-sans: Expressive up top, smooth below. General Sans draws round letters like bent wire with a steady pressure, and General Sans keeps its x-height filling the line, so Baloo 2's open, bowl-heavy display shapes get a sleek partner.
